title: Bug with facets and no results
body:
It is reproducible on the demo : just put a random string in the search box, it throws an error : 

```
e.getFacetValues(...).data is null
```

While implementing on Shopify, the error was with the slider first, but it might be all facet widgets:

```
TypeError: stats is undefined
```

for `range: { min: stats.min, max: stats.max }` in the slider code.

comments.body: If it's easily reproducible on the demo and if you have time maybe you can have a look?
I've managed to fix the issue on the menu widget, but not sure what the best behavior for empty min/max is for the slider. Just do not display it?
We are working on the same issue :D
I'll let you handle it @pixelastic no big deal, to avoid this state next time: assign and move the task on waffle.io. I had moved it but not obvious (ready instead of doing).
